pptx-work-report.label: 工作汇报
pptx-work-report.description: 季度指标达成与人效归因
pptx-work-report.prompt: 基于我提供的季度数据，输出不少于 9 页的季度工作汇报演示：封面含 3 个关键指标与达成判定表，其后依次是目录、背景与统计口径、现状数据表与月度走势图、归因分析、四维评估框架、重构前后对比、风险与依赖、结论与分阶段行动；同一指标跨页数字必须一致，风险页要给出缓解措施与责任人。

pptx-education.label: 教学课件
pptx-education.description: 中学课堂行星科普课件
pptx-education.prompt: 制作一套不少于 9 页的中学课堂课件，主题为太阳系与行星探索：含课堂流程与时间分配、教学目标与学情分析、八大行星数据表与直径对比图、类地与巨行星的三点差异、轨道结构示意、六颗行星特征对照表、常见误区、课堂小结与作业；每页至少一处可视化，口径统一为 1 AU = 1.5 亿公里。

pptx-ai-intro.label: AI 入门
pptx-ai-intro.description: 零基础 AI 认知通识课
pptx-ai-intro.prompt: 面向非技术同事制作不少于 9 页的人工智能通识讲稿：三个问题的一句话回答表、内部 6 类场景的使用率与满意度、能力边界与幻觉率分层、数据到推理的四步链条与三类模型、传统软件与 AI 系统的六点差异、风险清单与使用纪律、三条原则与五条上手清单；全程不得出现代码。

pptx-training.label: 培训课件
pptx-training.description: 三天上手路径与考核标准
pptx-training.prompt: 制作不少于 9 页的新同事入职培训课件：四天课程安排与时间投入、培训对象与前置条件、近三期新人的上手耗时数据与对比图、三类卡点量化分析、能力地图四层自评清单、常见误区与正确做法对照、风险与导师投入测算、考核标准与资源清单；每页都要给出可逐条勾选的具体条目。

pptx-product-plan.label: 产品方案
pptx-product-plan.prompt: 制作不少于 9 页的产品方案评审演示：需求背景与问题定义、18 类工单分布与日均量、三条可自动化的收益判断与三段提升路径、四层能力架构与逐层降级策略、三个版本节奏与前后指标对比、风险登记与缓解措施、里程碑与验收标准；要讲清方案取舍的理由、资源投入与不做的边界。

pptx-content-research.label: 行业调研
pptx-content-research.description: 规模、格局与机会点判断
pptx-content-research.prompt: 制作不少于 9 页的行业调研汇报：调研问题与统计口径、4 个细分行业的规模增速与渗透率、三条核心结论及支撑数据、部署模式与数据可控性的四象限竞争格局、8 项能力的竞品横向对比、研究局限与样本偏差、结论与三步行动及数据来源清单；同一规模数字跨页必须一致。

pptx-annual-review.label: 年度经营复盘
pptx-annual-review.description: 营收、毛利与现金流复盘
pptx-annual-review.prompt: 制作不少于 9 页的年度经营复盘：合并报表口径与调整说明、三条业务线的收入与毛利结构、收入增量归因与毛利率下滑拆解、增长与毛利四象限及净利率杜邦拆解、年初经营目标的达成对照、经营风险与缓解措施、2027 年目标与三个必赢战役；所有数字须能与总账口径相互验算。

pptx-fundraising.label: 融资路演
pptx-fundraising.description: 增长、单位经济与融资条款
pptx-fundraising.prompt: 制作不少于 9 页的 A 轮融资路演：公司与目标市场、四年 ARR 曲线与经营指标、单位经济模型推导链（ARPU 到 LTV/CAC）、收入结构与交付流程、与 3 家可比公司的对照、客户集中度与敏感性分析、资金用途与 2027 里程碑及本轮条款；所有数字须能相互验算，假设写明。

image-to-excel.label: 图片转表格
image-to-excel.description: 拍照台账识别为可编辑表格
image-to-excel.prompt: 把 10 张纸质台账照片识别成结构化表格：自动检测表格线、逐格 OCR 并给出置信度，低于 0.90 的单元格进入人工复核队列。输出不少于 8 页的识别报告，含处理流水线、字段字典、照片级明细、误差归因、校验规则与后续动作，并给出字段准确率与置信度分布。

excel-summary.label: 销售汇总
excel-summary.description: 季度销售按区域品类汇总
excel-summary.prompt: 读取销售明细工作簿，按区域、渠道、品类三个维度做季度汇总并计算环比与占比。输出不少于 8 页的表格式分析报告：封面摘要、Sheet 总览、口径与字段字典、区域与品类明细、渠道结构、异常清单、校验规则、结论与动作、附录，所有数字跨页必须一致。

multi-excel-merge.label: 多表合并
multi-excel-merge.description: 区域分表合并统一口径总表
multi-excel-merge.prompt: 把三个区域分表合并成统一口径总表：识别列名差异、统一金额单位与日期格式、按订单号跨文件去重，并处理区域缺失与状态越界。输出不少于 8 页的合并报告，含合并流程、列名映射、去重明细、口径冲突、校验规则与处理动作，保留来源文件与行号便于回溯。

word-report.label: 数据成报告
word-report.description: 数据自动生成经营分析报告
word-report.prompt: 基于销售与成本数据自动生成月度经营分析报告：计算环比、毛利率、新签占比与履约时长，并按章节成稿。输出不少于 8 页的报告，含章节结构、口径与取数、产品线与成本明细、效率达成、异常清单、校验规则、结论与动作、附录，引用数字须与源表逐一对齐。

excel-budget.label: 预算与预警
excel-budget.description: 预算占用分析与超支预测
excel-budget.prompt: 分析 2026Q4 部门预算执行：按科目与部门两侧统计已占用、使用率与消耗倍数，预测 11—12 月支出并给出超支预警。输出不少于 8 页的预算分析报告，含预算总览、口径字典、执行与预测明细、部门分解、异常清单、校验规则与科目调剂动作。

excel-reconcile.label: 逐单对账
excel-reconcile.description: 系统与渠道逐单勾稽差异
excel-reconcile.prompt: 把系统台账与渠道对账文件逐单勾稽：双向匹配订单号、比对金额并按容差自动勾稽，再把超容差差异归因到渠道缺单、退款未同步、手续费口径与四舍五入四类。输出不少于 8 页的对账报告，含差异明细、归因分析、未达账项台账、校验规则与处置动作。

excel-pivot.label: 多维透视
excel-pivot.description: 渠道品类交叉透视与贡献分解
excel-pivot.prompt: 对销售明细做渠道 × 品类多维透视：生成交叉矩阵并校验行合计、列合计与明细一致，再对品类与渠道做增量贡献分解。输出不少于 8 页的透视分析报告，含透视结构、维度字典、明细与贡献分解、交叉矩阵、异常格、校验规则、结论与处理动作。

excel-anomaly.label: 异常检测
excel-anomaly.description: 报销异常识别与风险分级
excel-anomaly.prompt: 对当月 4,286 笔费用报销做异常检测：用阈值、频次与分布三类规则识别异常，并按高、中、低三级分级。输出不少于 8 页的检测报告，含检测流程、字段口径、规则命中明细、部门分布、异常倍数、规则有效性校验与分阶段处置动作。

edu-english-words.label: 英语单词学习
edu-english-words.prompt: 请写一份不少于 10 页的英语词汇讲义,讲 resilient 与 salire 词根家族:含学习目标与路径、构词法脉络、词义演化与 8 个搭配、6 类常见错误、12 道分层练习及逐题解析、自测清单、30 天计划与术语表附录。每条要点都要给具体词例与数字,跨页数据必须自洽。

edu-math-explain.label: 数学题讲解
edu-math-explain.description: 数学难题的详细解题过程
edu-math-explain.prompt: 请写一份不少于 10 页的数学讲义,讲解二次函数在闭区间上的最值:含学习目标与路径、知识脉络、配方与对称轴的分类讨论(轴在区间左、内、右三种情形)、常见错误对照表、12 道分层练习及逐题解析、自测清单与下一阶段计划、术语表附录。每道题都要给出具体函数与区间,跨页数值必须一致。

edu-essay-writing.label: 作文写作辅导
edu-essay-writing.prompt: 请写一份不少于 10 页的记叙文写作讲义,以《我的第一次远行》为例讲细节描写:含学习目标与路径、五感细节脉络、8 组原文与改写对照、6 类常见错误、12 道分层练习及逐题解析、自测清单与 12 周写作计划、术语表附录。改写示范要具体到可以照抄的句子,跨页数字自洽。

edu-knowledge-explain.label: 知识点科普
edu-knowledge-explain.description: 用通俗语言解释复杂知识
edu-knowledge-explain.prompt: 请写一份不少于 10 页的科普讲义,讲解光合作用:含学习目标与路径、光反应与暗反应的知识脉络、总反应式与生活类比、6 类常见错误与光合呼吸对照表、12 道理解题及逐题解析、自测清单与 4 周探究计划、术语表附录。要给出具体的物质收支数字,并保证跨页一致。

edu-study-plan.label: 学习计划制定
edu-study-plan.description: 把备考目标拆成可执行计划
edu-study-plan.prompt: 请写一份不少于 10 页的四级备考计划书:含学习目标与路径、分数目标与每周投入口径、12 周三阶段计划表、6 类常见执行失误与计划实际对照、12 道计划诊断题及解析、自测清单与滚动修订方案、术语表附录。所有时长与产出数字要能互相对上,并说明按周如何调整。

edu-mistake-review.label: 错题复盘
edu-mistake-review.description: 定位错因并给出改进动作
edu-mistake-review.prompt: 请写一份不少于 10 页的错题复盘讲义,以方程 2x² + 3x − 5 = 0 为例:含学习目标与路径、错因占比图、错误与正确解法对照、判别式 Δ = 49 的完整计算、6 类常见错误、12 道变式练习及逐题解析、自测清单、下一阶段计划与术语表附录,并给出一页错题卡模板。

edu-class-activity.label: 课堂活动设计
edu-class-activity.description: 为教师设计可落地的课堂活动
edu-class-activity.prompt: 请为初中物理教师写一份不少于 10 页的课堂活动设计讲义,主题是一节 40 分钟的《浮力》探究课:含设计目标与路径、六环节时间轴与分组器材清单、教师与学生行为对照表、6 类常见失误、12 道教学设计诊断题及解析、自测清单、单元计划与术语表附录。各环节时长合计必须等于 40 分钟。

edu-lab-report.label: 实验报告
edu-lab-report.description: 规范记录数据并分析误差
edu-lab-report.prompt: 请写一份不少于 10 页的化学实验报告讲义,主题是用 0.1000 mol/L 标准盐酸滴定氢氧化钠溶液:含报告结构、仪器清单与原理、三次平行滴定的数据表与浓度计算、6 类操作误差及偏大偏小分析、12 道计算题及解析、自测清单、下一阶段计划与术语表附录。各数值与单位必须全篇一致。

web-resume.description: 衬线排版的在线简历与作品集

web-store.description: 器物目录风格的门店展示与菜单页

web-event.description: 夜色请柬,含倒计时、流程与回执

web-product-launch.description: 瑞士网格风格的技术产品发布页

web-ops-console.label: 运营看板
web-ops-console.description: 异常优先的运营监控看板

web-survey.label: 调查问卷
web-survey.description: 吸顶进度条的专注型表单

web-game-snake.label: 小游戏：贪吃蛇
web-game-snake.description: 单文件贪吃蛇,三档速度与本机战绩

web-game-2048.label: 小游戏：2048 合并
web-game-2048.description: 单文件 2048,含分值梯度与一步撤销

research-industry.label: 行业趋势研究
research-industry.description: 行业规模、驱动因素与趋势判断
research-industry.prompt: 围绕「本地优先 AI 工具」做行业趋势研究，输出不少于 10 页报告：界定口径与数据来源，给出行业规模、细分分布与三年变化（含图表），拆解政策、技术、需求、供给四类驱动因素，列出附数字证据的关键洞察，做三种情景推演，写明信息缺口、风险与分阶段动作。数字须标注来源与时间窗。

research-competitors.label: 竞品分析
research-competitors.description: 竞品能力矩阵与可切入位置
research-competitors.prompt: 对 6 家直接竞品做对标分析，输出不少于 10 页报告：定义竞品集合、评估维度与权重，给出功能、成本、数据可控、生态四维评分矩阵与可视化，做定位象限与结构性缺口分析，逐条列洞察并附评分证据，推演竞品降价或补短板后的情景，给出产品、定价与打法建议。价格与评分须注明来源。

research-policy.label: 政策解读
research-policy.description: 监管文本要点与合规影响面
research-policy.prompt: 解读新发布的生成式 AI 管理办法及两份配套指引，输出不少于 10 页解读报告：列明文本版本、适用范围与口径，把条款拆成义务清单并标注触发条件与可验证证据，评估数据采集、模型训练、对外服务、内部使用四个环节的影响强度，做三种执法情景推演，给出倒排时间表与责任分工。

research-literature.label: 文献综述
research-literature.description: 研究脉络、观点聚类与证据强度
research-literature.prompt: 围绕「本地推理与数据主权」做文献综述，输出不少于 10 页报告：写明检索式、数据库、纳排标准与各阶段筛选数量，给出年份、方法、主题三维分布，拆解每个主题的核心观点并标注支撑文献数与证据强度，单列一页说明研究间冲突与未解问题，写明检索局限与偏倚。每条观点可回溯到文献编号。

research-user.label: 用户调研
research-user.description: 访谈样本、需求优先级与痛点
research-user.prompt: 针对目标用户做访谈式需求研究，输出不少于 10 页报告：交代样本结构与访谈脚本，给出编码流程各阶段数量，按需求提及率与当前满足度排出优先级，列出痛点频次与带出处的一线原话，做三档投入范围的情景推演，最后写明自报偏差等信息缺口与分阶段落地建议。每个结论须可回溯到样本量与访谈编号。

research-market-entry.label: 市场进入评估
research-market-entry.description: 区域可行性、节奏与前置条件
research-market-entry.prompt: 评估东南亚六个市场的进入可行性，输出不少于 10 页报告：先给评估框架与四维权重（需求、获客成本、合规门槛、交付），再列六市场数据表与图形对比，逐一给出进入、观望或暂缓的判断与理由，做三种情景推演（含毛利转正月份），写明前置条件、信息缺口与投入节奏。数据须标注口径与时间窗。

research-supply-chain.label: 供应链风险
research-supply-chain.description: 关键物料断供与涨价风险扫描
research-supply-chain.prompt: 对 AI 硬件关键物料做风险扫描，输出不少于 10 页报告：先给评分口径（集中度、交期、价格、替代权重），再列出 8 类物料的家数、交期、涨价与单一来源占比并打分，按集中度与替代性分层拆解，列出附证据的洞察，推演断供、涨价与替代成熟三种情景，给出库存与双源策略及信息缺口。

research-talent.label: 人才市场调研
research-talent.description: 岗位供需、薪酬分位与招聘周期
research-talent.prompt: 针对六个目标岗位做人才市场调研，输出不少于 10 页报告：交代岗位定义、薪酬口径与数据来源，给出需求、候选人、缺口比、薪酬与周期的数据表与分布图，按缺口比与薪酬水平做二维分层，列出附证据的洞察，推演涨薪、内培与远程用工三种情景，给出分位目标与招聘节奏。

academic-outline.label: 论文大纲
academic-outline.description: 五章十八节提纲与排期
academic-outline.prompt: 为我正在写的硕士学位论文《面向中型团队的本地优先智能体协作流程研究》输出一份中文论文大纲，不少于 8 页：含标题页与摘要、目录与篇幅分配、逐节提纲（含二三级标题）、研究问题与方法对应矩阵、图表清单、写作排期与里程碑，以及 10 条以上按引用顺序编号的参考文献与术语表。

academic-polish.label: 学术润色
academic-polish.description: 逐句润色并标注修改理由
academic-polish.prompt: 润色我的论文全文语言表达，输出不少于 8 页的润色报告：分章节给出修改前与修改后对照（保留原意、逐处标注理由）、统一术语与搭配、规范数字单位与统计表述、明确各章节时态与人称，并附逐句修改清单、修改前后评分与参考文献格式检查结果。

academic-review.label: 文献综述
academic-review.description: 文献脉络梳理与研究缺口
academic-review.prompt: 围绕「端侧推理与团队协作流程」做一篇系统文献综述，输出不少于 8 页：写明数据库、检索式、纳入排除标准与筛选一致性系数，按三条研究脉络逐篇归类并给出结论量级与局限，做方法学质量评价，用证据矩阵指出研究缺口，最后给出 20 条以上按编号引用的参考文献。

academic-data-analysis.label: 数据统计
academic-data-analysis.description: 问卷信效度与回归结果呈现
academic-data-analysis.prompt: 把我收集的 412 份有效问卷做成完整的数据分析章节，不少于 8 页：含样本回收与清洗流程、变量与题项说明、描述统计与相关矩阵、信度效度检验、组间差异检验、多元回归与中介分析、稳健性检验，以及假设检验汇总表，所有图表须编号并与正文数字一致。

academic-method.label: 研究方法
academic-method.description: 准实验设计与变量操作化
academic-method.prompt: 把我的研究设计写成可复现的研究方法章节，不少于 8 页：含研究假设与逐条判定标准、变量操作化定义与测量方式、样本分组与功效分析、干预流程与投放节奏、数据采集口径与质量控制、双重差分等分析模型，以及伦理审查与数据保护安排，并附量表条目与日志字段清单。

academic-defense.label: 答辩提纲
academic-defense.description: 汇报时序与十二问应答要点
academic-defense.prompt: 帮我准备硕士学位论文答辩，输出不少于 8 页的答辩材料：含 20 分钟汇报的五个部分与逐页要点、时间分配表、结果与结论页的关键数据（带统计量与置信区间）、12 个高概率提问及应答要点与证据索引、答辩流程与材料清单，并附完整的幻灯片清单。

academic-grant.label: 研究计划书
academic-grant.description: 立项依据、路线与经费预算
academic-grant.prompt: 按青年科学基金申报要求写一份研究计划书，不少于 8 页：含立项依据与关键科学问题、国内外研究现状与不足、研究内容与技术路线、创新点与可行性分析、三年进度与里程碑、预期成果与考核指标、逐科目经费预算（金额与占比须合计一致），以及研究基础与参考文献。

academic-ethics.label: 伦理审查
academic-ethics.description: 知情同意、风险与数据保护
academic-ethics.prompt: 为一项涉及人的流程干预研究准备伦理审查送审材料，不少于 8 页：含研究概述与科学必要性、受试者招募与纳入排除标准、知情同意流程与告知要素、风险与受益评估及控制措施、数据隐私保护与保存销毁安排、利益冲突与补偿、退出机制，以及审查要点自查清单与法规依据。

docs-meeting.label: 会议纪要
docs-meeting.description: 整理讨论内容与行动项
docs-meeting.prompt: 请把我提供的会议记录整理成正式会议纪要，交付不少于 8 页的文档：封面摘要、参会人员与议程、逐议题讨论及数据依据、决议事项、行动项清单（含负责人、时限与验收标准）、风险与未决事项、下次会议安排与附录。条款与编号须跨页连续，每项决议可逐条追溯。

docs-report.label: 工作报告
docs-report.description: 生成结构清晰的正式报告
docs-report.prompt: 请根据我提供的材料撰写一份不少于 10 页的正式工作报告：编制说明与数据口径、总体指标对比、分区域与分业务线数据表、重点工作完成度评价、问题归因分析、下阶段计划与资源需求、风险提示与附录。全部数字须标注来源，跨页同一指标必须一致。

docs-summary.label: 文档摘要
docs-summary.prompt: 请阅读我提供的长文档，输出不少于 8 页的结构化摘要：原文概况与篇幅构成、研究方法与样本说明、核心发现（逐条附支撑数据）、结论与行动建议、局限与待确认问题、术语表与数据出处索引。引用的每个数字都要标注原文页码。

docs-polish.label: 文档润色
docs-polish.prompt: 请润色我提供的文档，交付不少于 8 页的润色稿：润色总览与问题类型分布、逐段修改前后对照（含每处修改理由）、数字与术语校核表、可直接使用的定稿全文、逐条修改清单与发布前检查清单。事实、数字、责任主体与结论一律不得改动。

docs-prd.label: 需求文档
docs-prd.description: 产品需求说明与验收标准
docs-prd.prompt: 请帮我写一份产品需求文档（PRD），交付不少于 10 页：背景与目标、用户角色与使用场景、功能需求清单（含优先级与验收标准）、核心流程与异常分支、埋点与指标定义、非功能需求与验收方式、本期不做范围与依赖假设、排期与风险及附录。

docs-notice.label: 通知公告
docs-notice.description: 内部通知与公告文书起草
docs-notice.prompt: 请起草一份公司内部通知，交付不少于 8 页：标题与文号、制定依据与背景数据、调整内容条款、操作步骤、执行要求与自查清单、生效时间与过渡安排、口径问答、监督问责，以及含模板字段与联系方式的附录。条款编号须全文连续。

docs-sop.label: 作业流程
docs-sop.description: 标准作业流程与检查清单
docs-sop.prompt: 请编写一份标准作业流程（SOP），交付不少于 8 页：目的、适用范围与术语、角色与职责矩阵、流程总览与判定点、分步作业要求（含时限）、异常与例外处理、质量检查与考核、培训与生效安排，以及值班检查清单等附录。

docs-api.label: 接口文档
docs-api.description: 开放接口说明与联调清单
docs-api.prompt: 请为我们的开放平台编写接口文档，交付不少于 10 页：接入准备与鉴权算法、通用请求与响应规范、接口清单与权限矩阵、各接口的请求响应示例与错误码、回调订阅与重试策略、限流配额、联调检查清单与字段字典。

pptx-work-report.label: Quarterly Report
pptx-work-report.prompt: Turn my quarterly data into a slide deck of at least 9 pages: a cover with three key metrics and an attainment table, then agenda, scope and methodology, current-state tables with a monthly trend chart, attribution analysis, a four-dimension evaluation framework, a before/after comparison, risks and dependencies, and conclusions with a phased action plan. Keep every metric consistent across pages and name an owner for each risk mitigation.

pptx-education.label: Teaching Deck
pptx-education.description: Middle-school science deck on the solar system
pptx-education.prompt: Build a classroom deck of at least 9 pages on the solar system and planetary exploration: lesson flow and timing, objectives and student analysis, a data table plus a diameter comparison chart for the eight planets, three differences between terrestrial and giant planets, an orbit diagram, a physical-feature comparison of six planets, common misconceptions, and a summary with homework. Every page needs one visualization, using 1 AU = 150 million km.

pptx-ai-intro.label: AI Literacy Talk
pptx-ai-intro.description: Plain-language AI basics for non-technical staff
pptx-ai-intro.prompt: Create an AI literacy deck of at least 9 pages for non-technical colleagues: one-line answers to what it is, how it works and where to use it; internal usage and satisfaction across six scenarios; capability boundaries with hallucination rates; the four-step data-to-inference chain and three model types; six differences between traditional software and AI systems; a risk list with usage discipline; and three principles plus a five-item checklist. No code anywhere.

pptx-training.label: Onboarding Deck
pptx-training.prompt: Produce an onboarding deck of at least 9 pages: the four-day schedule and time budget, audience and prerequisites, onboarding-time data for the last three cohorts with a comparison chart, quantified blockers, a four-layer capability map with a self-check list, a misconception-versus-practice table, risks and mentor effort, and assessment criteria with a resource list. Every page must offer concrete, checkable items.

pptx-product-plan.label: Product Proposal
pptx-product-plan.description: Requirements, release plan and resource estimate
pptx-product-plan.prompt: Build a product proposal deck of at least 9 pages: background and problem definition, ticket distribution across 18 categories with daily volumes, three automation opportunities with a three-stage efficiency path, a four-layer architecture with per-layer degradation, the release plan and before/after metrics, a risk register, and milestones with acceptance criteria. Explain the trade-offs, the resource ask and what is explicitly out of scope.

pptx-content-research.label: Market Research
pptx-content-research.description: Market size, landscape and opportunity gaps
pptx-content-research.prompt: Create a market research deck of at least 9 pages: research questions and methodology, size, growth and penetration for four sub-industries, three core findings with supporting data, a four-quadrant competitive map by deployment model and data control, an eight-dimension competitor comparison, study limitations and sample bias, and conclusions with a three-step plan and a source list. Market-size figures must match across pages.

pptx-annual-review.label: Annual Review
pptx-annual-review.prompt: Produce an annual business review deck of at least 9 pages: consolidated reporting scope and adjustments, revenue and gross-margin structure across three business lines, revenue-increment attribution and a gross-margin decline breakdown, a growth-versus-margin quadrant with a net-margin decomposition, actual results against the year's targets, operating risks, and 2027 goals with three must-win battles. All figures must reconcile with the ledger.

pptx-fundraising.label: Series A Pitch
pptx-fundraising.description: Growth, unit economics and Series A terms
pptx-fundraising.prompt: Build a Series A pitch deck of at least 9 pages: company and target market, a four-year ARR curve with operating metrics, the unit-economics chain from ARPU to LTV/CAC, revenue mix and delivery process, a benchmark comparison with three comparable companies, customer concentration and sensitivity analysis, and use of proceeds with 2027 milestones and deal terms. Every financial figure must be verifiable and assumptions stated.

image-to-excel.label: Photo to Table
image-to-excel.description: Turn photos of ledgers into tables
image-to-excel.prompt: Turn 10 photos of paper ledgers into a structured table: detect grid lines, OCR every cell with a confidence score, and route cells below 0.90 to human review. Deliver a report of 8+ pages covering the pipeline, field dictionary, per-photo detail, error causes, validation rules and next actions, plus accuracy and confidence distributions.

excel-summary.label: Sales Summary
excel-summary.description: Quarterly sales by region and category
excel-summary.prompt: Summarise the sales workbook by region, channel and category with period-on-period change and shares. Deliver an 8+ page tabular report: summary cover, sheet map, caliber and field dictionary, region and category detail, channel mix, anomaly list, validation rules, conclusions, actions and appendix, with figures consistent across pages.

multi-excel-merge.label: Merge Workbooks
multi-excel-merge.description: Merge regional sheets into one table
multi-excel-merge.prompt: Merge three regional sheets into one standard-caliber table: map differing column names, normalise amount units and date formats, de-duplicate by order id across files, and fix missing regions and out-of-range statuses. Deliver an 8+ page merge report with lineage back to source file and row number.

word-report.label: Data to Report
word-report.prompt: Auto-draft the monthly business review from sales and cost data, computing period-on-period growth, gross margin, new-sign share and fulfilment time. Deliver an 8+ page document with chapter structure, calibers, product and cost detail, efficiency gaps, anomaly list, validation rules, conclusions and actions, every cited figure aligned to the source tables.

excel-budget.label: Budget Watch
excel-budget.prompt: Analyse Q4 department budget execution: report committed amount, utilisation and burn multiple by account and by department, forecast November-December spend and flag overspend. Deliver an 8+ page budget report with forecast detail, department breakdown, anomaly list, validation rules and reallocation actions.

excel-reconcile.label: Ledger Recon
excel-reconcile.prompt: Reconcile the ledger against the channel statement order by order: two-way match on order id, compare amounts, auto-match within tolerance, and root-cause every out-of-tolerance difference into missing order, refund lag, fee basis or rounding. Deliver an 8+ page report with a pending-items ledger and actions.

excel-pivot.label: Pivot Analysis
excel-pivot.prompt: Build a channel x category pivot from the sales detail, validate that row totals, column totals and the detail table agree, then decompose growth by category and channel. Deliver an 8+ page pivot report with dimension dictionary, contribution analysis, the full matrix, anomaly cells, validation rules and actions.

excel-anomaly.label: Anomaly Screen
excel-anomaly.description: Detect expense anomalies by risk level
excel-anomaly.prompt: Screen 4,286 expense claims for anomalies using threshold, frequency and distribution rules, then grade every hit as high, medium or low risk. Deliver an 8+ page report covering the detection pipeline, field calibers, rule-hit detail, department distribution, deviation multiples, rule validation and phased actions.

edu-english-words.label: English Vocabulary
edu-english-words.prompt: Write a vocabulary handout of at least 10 pages for high-school or CET-4 learners, built around the word resilient and the Latin root salire: learning goals and path, word-formation map with a corpus frequency chart, meaning evolution plus 8 real collocations, a table of 6 error types, 12 graded exercises with per-question answers, a self-check list, a 30-day plan and a glossary appendix. Every point needs concrete words and numbers, consistent across pages.

edu-math-explain.label: Math Problem Explanation
edu-math-explain.description: Detailed solution process for math problems
edu-math-explain.prompt: Write a math handout of at least 10 pages on the maximum and minimum of a quadratic function over a closed interval: learning goals and path, concept map, completing the square and the three axis-position cases (axis left of, inside, right of the interval), a table of common errors, 12 graded exercises with per-question answers, a self-check list, the next-stage plan and a glossary appendix. Every item must use concrete functions and intervals with consistent values.

edu-essay-writing.label: Essay Writing Guidance
edu-essay-writing.prompt: Write a narrative-writing handout of at least 10 pages on concrete detail, using My First Long Trip as the worked example: learning goals and path, a five-senses detail map, 8 before-and-after rewrites, 6 common error types, 12 graded exercises with answers, a self-check list, a 12-week writing plan and a glossary appendix. Each rewrite must be a sentence a student can copy, with consistent figures across pages.

edu-knowledge-explain.label: Knowledge Explanation
edu-knowledge-explain.description: Explain complex knowledge in simple language
edu-knowledge-explain.prompt: Write a popular-science handout of at least 10 pages explaining photosynthesis: learning goals and path, a concept map of the light and dark reactions, the overall equation with an everyday analogy, 6 common error types plus a photosynthesis-versus-respiration comparison table, 12 comprehension questions with answers, a self-check list, a 4-week inquiry plan and a glossary appendix. Include concrete matter-balance numbers that stay consistent.

edu-study-plan.label: Study Plan
edu-study-plan.description: Turn a goal into an executable study plan
edu-study-plan.prompt: Write a CET-4 study plan of at least 10 pages: learning goals and path, score target and weekly time budget, a 12-week three-stage plan table, 6 common execution failures with a planned-versus-actual comparison, 12 plan-diagnosis questions with answers, a self-check list, a rolling revision scheme and a glossary appendix. Every duration and output figure must reconcile across pages.

edu-mistake-review.label: Mistake Review
edu-mistake-review.description: Find the root cause of a wrong answer
edu-mistake-review.prompt: Write a mistake-review handout of at least 10 pages using the equation 2x² + 3x − 5 = 0: learning goals and path, a chart of error-cause shares, a wrong-versus-correct solution comparison, the full computation with discriminant Δ = 49, 6 common error types, 12 variant exercises with answers, a self-check list, the next-stage plan and a glossary appendix, plus a one-page mistake-card template.

edu-class-activity.label: Class Activity Design
edu-class-activity.prompt: Write a classroom-activity design handout of at least 10 pages for a middle-school physics teacher, covering one 40-minute inquiry lesson on buoyancy: design goals and path, a timeline of six stages with grouping and equipment lists, a teacher-versus-student behaviour table, 6 common pitfalls, 12 design-diagnosis questions with answers, a self-check list, a unit plan and a glossary appendix. Stage durations must total exactly 40 minutes.

edu-lab-report.label: Lab Report
edu-lab-report.description: Record data properly and analyze errors
edu-lab-report.prompt: Write a chemistry lab-report handout of at least 10 pages on titrating sodium hydroxide solution with 0.1000 mol/L standard hydrochloric acid: report structure, apparatus list and principle, a data table for three parallel titrations with the concentration calculation, 6 operational error types with high-or-low bias analysis, 12 calculation questions with answers, a self-check list, the next-stage plan and a glossary appendix. Concentrations, volumes and units must be consistent throughout.

web-resume.label: Personal Resume
web-resume.description: Online resume and portfolio in an editorial serif setting

web-store.label: Store Homepage
web-store.description: Craft catalog shop and menu page

web-event.label: Event Invitation
web-event.description: Night invitation with a countdown, schedule and RSVP

web-product-launch.label: Product Launch Page
web-product-launch.description: Technical product launch page in a Swiss grid style

web-ops-console.label: Operations Console

web-survey.label: Survey Questionnaire
web-survey.description: Focused form document with a sticky progress bar

web-game-snake.label: Mini-game: Snake
web-game-snake.description: Single-file snake with three speeds and run history

web-game-2048.label: Mini-game: 2048
web-game-2048.description: Single-file 2048 with a tile ladder and one-step undo

research-industry.label: Industry Trend Study
research-industry.description: Industry size, drivers and trend calls
research-industry.prompt: Run an industry trend study on local-first AI tooling. Deliver a structured report of at least 10 pages: define scope and data sources first, then cover market size, sub-industry distribution and three-year movement with tables and charts, break down policy/technology/demand/supply drivers, list key insights each backed by a number, build three scenarios, and close with information gaps, risks and a phased action plan. Every figure needs a source, time window and definition.

research-competitors.label: Competitor Analysis
research-competitors.prompt: Benchmark six direct competitors and deliver a report of at least 10 pages: define the competitor set, dimensions and weights; score feature coverage, cost, data control and ecosystem with charts; map positioning quadrants and structural gaps; list insights each with scoring evidence; model scenarios where a rival cuts price or closes a gap; and finish with product, pricing and go-to-market calls plus information gaps. Cite the source and date of every price and score.

research-policy.label: Policy Brief
research-policy.prompt: Interpret the new generative AI measures plus two companion guidelines in a compliance brief of at least 10 pages: state the text versions, scope and definitions; convert every clause into a duty list with trigger conditions and verifiable evidence; rate impact on data collection, model training, public services and internal use; model three enforcement scenarios; and close with a week-by-week plan before the October effective date, owners per duty, and a standalone page of gaps and uncertainty. Not legal advice.

research-literature.label: Literature Review
research-literature.prompt: Run a systematic literature review on local inference and data sovereignty. Deliver at least 10 pages: state the query, databases, inclusion and exclusion rules and the screening funnel with counts per stage; chart year, method and theme distributions; break down each theme's core claims with the number of supporting papers and an evidence-strength rating; add a full page on conflicting findings and open questions; and close with search limitations, coverage bias and a tracking plan. Every claim must map back to paper IDs.

research-user.label: User Research
research-user.description: Interview sample, needs and pain points
research-user.prompt: Run an interview-based needs study and deliver at least 10 pages: describe the sample structure and interview script; show the coding funnel with counts at each stage; rank needs on mention rate against current satisfaction; present pain-point frequencies with attributed quotes; model three investment scopes; and close with self-report and social-desirability bias, information gaps and a phased rollout plan. Every conclusion must trace back to a sample size and interview ID.

research-market-entry.label: Market Entry Study
research-market-entry.prompt: Assess entry feasibility for six Southeast Asian markets in a report of at least 10 pages: define the framework and four weighted dimensions (demand size, acquisition cost, compliance barrier, delivery capability); compare the six markets with tables and charts; give an enter/watch/defer call per market with reasons; model three scenarios including the month gross margin turns positive; and finish with prerequisites, information gaps and a phased investment cadence. Every figure needs a definition, source and time window.

research-supply-chain.label: Supply Chain Risk
research-supply-chain.description: Shortage and price risk of key parts
research-supply-chain.prompt: Scan supply risk across key AI hardware parts in a report of at least 10 pages: define scope and a four-factor risk score (supplier concentration, lead-time volatility, price movement, substitutability); list eight part groups with vendor counts, lead times, price change and single-source share, each scored; split them by concentration and substitutability; give insights with evidence; model shortage, price-hike and substitution scenarios; and close with safety-stock and dual-source plans, gaps and a phased action list.

research-talent.label: Talent Market Study
research-talent.description: Role supply, pay percentiles, time to hire
research-talent.prompt: Study the talent market for six target roles in at least 10 pages: define each role, the pay basis and data sources; tabulate open demand, available candidates, gap ratio, median pay and time to hire with three charts; layer roles by gap ratio against pay level; give insights with evidence; model pay-raise, internal-training and remote-hiring scenarios; and close with pay-percentile targets, hiring cadence, information gaps and a phased plan.

academic-outline.label: Thesis Outline
academic-outline.prompt: Draft a deliverable Chinese thesis outline of at least 8 pages for my master's thesis on local-first agent collaboration workflows: title and abstract, contents with length allocation, section-by-section outline to three heading levels, a research-question-to-method matrix, figure and table list, writing schedule and milestones, plus 10+ numbered references and a glossary.

academic-polish.label: Academic Polish
academic-polish.prompt: Polish the language of my full thesis and produce a report of at least 8 pages: before-and-after revision pairs per chapter with a stated reason for every change, unified terminology and collocations, standardised numbers, units and statistical phrasing, chapter-by-chapter tense and person rules, a sentence-level change log, before-and-after scores and a reference-format check.

academic-review.label: Literature Review
academic-review.prompt: Produce a systematic literature review of at least 8 pages on on-device inference and team collaboration workflows: databases, search strings, inclusion and exclusion criteria with inter-rater agreement, three thematic strands with effect sizes and limitations, a methodological quality appraisal, an evidence matrix locating the research gaps, and 20+ numbered references.

academic-data-analysis.label: Data Analysis
academic-data-analysis.prompt: Turn my 412 valid questionnaire responses into a full data-analysis chapter of at least 8 pages: sample recovery and cleaning, variables and item wording, descriptive statistics and correlations, reliability and validity tests, group comparisons, multiple regression with mediation, robustness checks and a hypothesis-summary table, with every figure and table numbered and matching the text.

academic-method.label: Research Method
academic-method.prompt: Write my study design as a reproducible methods chapter of at least 8 pages: hypotheses with explicit decision criteria, operational definitions and measurement for every variable, sampling and power analysis, the intervention rollout schedule, data-collection rules and quality control, difference-in-differences and other models, plus ethics and data-protection arrangements and scale items.

academic-defense.label: Defense Brief
academic-defense.description: Timing plan and twelve Q&A briefs
academic-defense.prompt: Prepare my master's thesis defence with at least 8 pages of material: the five parts of a 20-minute presentation with per-slide talking points, a timing table, key results with test statistics and confidence intervals, twelve likely committee questions with answer points and evidence references, the defence procedure and material checklist, and a slide list.

academic-grant.label: Grant Proposal
academic-grant.prompt: Write a research proposal of at least 8 pages to the Young Scientists Fund format: rationale and key scientific questions, domestic and international state of the art with gaps, research content and technical roadmap, innovation and feasibility, a three-year schedule with milestones, expected outputs and assessment metrics, a line-item budget whose amounts and shares reconcile, and prior work.

academic-ethics.label: Ethics Review
academic-ethics.description: Consent, risk controls and data protection
academic-ethics.prompt: Prepare ethics review submission materials of at least 8 pages for a human-subjects workflow study: research overview and scientific necessity, participant recruitment with inclusion and exclusion criteria, the informed-consent process and disclosure elements, risk and benefit assessment with mitigation, data privacy plus storage and destruction rules, conflicts of interest, compensation and withdrawal, and a self-check list.

docs-meeting.label: Meeting Minutes
docs-meeting.prompt: Turn my meeting notes into formal minutes of at least 8 pages: cover summary, attendees and agenda, per-topic discussion with supporting data, resolutions, an action list with owners, deadlines and acceptance criteria, risks and open items, next meeting and annexes. Clause numbers must run continuously across pages.

docs-report.label: Work Report
docs-report.prompt: Write a formal work report of at least 10 pages from my materials: scope and metric definitions, headline KPI comparison, regional and business-line tables, key-work completion review, root-cause analysis, next-quarter plan and resource needs, risks and annexes. Every figure needs a source and must stay consistent across pages.

docs-summary.label: Document Summary
docs-summary.prompt: Read the long document I provide and return a structured summary of at least 8 pages: source overview and page composition, method and sample description, key findings each backed by data, conclusions and actions, limitations and open questions, glossary and a page index for every cited figure.

docs-polish.label: Document Editing
docs-polish.prompt: Edit my document and deliver at least 8 pages: an overview with the distribution of issue types, paragraph-by-paragraph before/after comparison with reasons, a numbers and terminology check table, the clean final text, and an itemised change list plus a pre-release checklist. Facts, numbers and conclusions must not change.

docs-prd.label: PRD
docs-prd.prompt: Write a product requirements document of at least 10 pages: background and goals, user roles and scenarios, a requirement list with priorities and acceptance criteria, core flow and exception branches, tracking events and metric definitions, non-functional requirements and acceptance method, out-of-scope items, roadmap, risks and annexes.

docs-notice.label: Notice
docs-notice.prompt: Draft an internal company notice of at least 8 pages: title and document number, basis and background data, the clauses being changed, step-by-step instructions, compliance requirements with a self-check list, effective date and transition plan, a Q&A section, supervision and accountability, plus an annex with form fields and contacts.

docs-sop.label: SOP
docs-sop.prompt: Write a standard operating procedure of at least 8 pages: purpose, scope and terms, a role and responsibility matrix, process overview with decision points, step-by-step work requirements with time limits, exception handling, quality checks and assessment, training and effective date, and appendices such as an on-shift checklist.

docs-api.label: API Reference
docs-api.description: Integration guide with schemas and error codes
docs-api.prompt: Write the API reference for our open platform in at least 10 pages: onboarding and signature authentication, general request and response conventions, an endpoint list with a permission matrix, request/response examples and error codes per endpoint, callback subscriptions and retry policy, rate limits and quotas, plus an integration checklist and field dictionary.
